dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (日医標準レセプトソフト) - GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL based, patient basic information retrieval API module

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software - patient basic information retrieval API subprogram
purpose.summary: This program is a subprogram in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that retrieves and returns patient basic information (name, kana name, birthday, sex, address, phone, insurance combinations, allergies, infection diseases, comments) via an XML response structure. It validates the patient number, reads patient master records, and formats the result into an XML response area for the API caller.

notable_features: Heavy use of COPY statements (25 copybooks) for JMA ORCA framework structures
XML output via ORCDBMAIN with XMLOPEN/XMLWRITE MCP function calls
LINKAGE SECTION with MCPAREA/SPAAREA/LINKAREA/SCRAREA pattern typical of ORCA
CALL to ORCSMCNDATE for machine date retrieval
CALL to ORCSPTID for patient ID conversion
CALL to ORCSHOSPNUM for hospital number setup
CALL to ORCSCOMMON for SPA common settings
Multiple COPY REPLACING for APILST variants
Japanese-encoded comments (EUC-JP rendered as latin-1 mojibake)
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS - uses proprietary ORCDBMAIN database interface
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually EUC-JP encoded Japanese text appearing as mojibake. Source is truncated at 16000 chars (full file is 29804 bytes, 737 lines). The program follows the standard JMA ORCA subprogram calling convention with MCP/SPA areas. Version annotation shows 04.07.00 dated 12/09/28 (2012-09-28).
